goal: Add coupon support to the cart. total(items, { coupon }) in src/cart.mjs applies a coupon whose rules live in a new module src/coupons.mjs. SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal, with the discount rounded down to whole cents (a 899-cent subtotal becomes 810). FLAT500 takes 500 cents off, but the total never goes below 0. Coupon codes are case-insensitive. An unknown coupon throws an Error whose message contains the code. Without a coupon (or with an empty options object) the total is unchanged. Add tests to test/cart.test.mjs. node --test must pass.

tasks.title: Coupons for the cart total
criteria: src/coupons.mjs holds the coupon rules; total(items, { coupon }) in src/cart.mjs applies them; without a coupon or with {} the total is unchanged.
SAVE10 takes 10% off with the discount rounded down to whole cents (899 becomes 810); FLAT500 takes 500 cents off and never goes below 0.
Codes are case-insensitive; an unknown code throws an Error whose message contains the code.
test/cart.test.mjs covers both coupons, case-insensitivity, the floor at 0 and unknown codes.
